blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Candidate-scoring decision models return a probability distribution over a presented set of answers. Public documentation of one such system, Jev, and of an open counterpart, JevAny, describes three training ingredients that determine what these probabilities estimate: soft targets from larger models, a frozen pretrained backbone and temperature calibration. We analyze each ingredient in Gaussian surrogates where the finite-sample risk can be computed exactly. A student trained on teacher targets inherits the teacher's bias, which more student data does not remove and agreement with the teacher does not reveal. A fixed representation lowers the risk only below an explicit sample-size threshold. In a probit model the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling, which removes all excess risk only when the teacher's coefficient has the correct direction and otherwise leaves a residual that calibration diagnostics do not detect. Under Luce's choice axiom, candidate scores are coherent across refinements of an event if and only if they aggregate by log-sum-exp. On 231,521 credit card complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, where the decision is whether a complaint ends in monetary relief, a student trained on a logistic teacher's probabilities ends at the teacher's decision cost while a student trained on outcomes goes 8% below it, a 30B model read zero-shot remains worse than the teacher after recalibration, and that model departs from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans. Pretrained representations reduce the labeled data required and calibration corrects the scale of the probabilities, but neither corrects a biased teacher, so the probabilities have to be checked against realized outcomes.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A candidate-scoring decision model receives a state, a question and a set of candidate answers, and it returns a probability for each candidate. When the candidates are a fixed set of class labels the model is a classifier with a text interface. The probability it returns estimates a conditional distribution, and the training targets determine which distribution that is. The probability that an event occurs, the probability that an annotator selects a candidate and the probability that a reference model assigns to a candidate are different conditional distributions, and a model can estimate one of them well while estimating the others poorly.
blocks.zh: 一个候选人评分决定模式得到一个州,一个问题和一组候选人答案,它为每个候选人返回一个概率. 当考生是一组固定的类标签时,模型是带有文本界面的分类器. 它返回的概率估计了有条件的分布,而训练目标决定的是哪种分布. 一个事件发生的概率,一个注释者选择一个候选人的概率,以及一个参考模型分配给一个候选人的概率是不同的有条件分布,一个模型可以很好地估计其中之一,同时估计其他的差.

blocks.en: Jev is a candidate-scoring model released by TypeSafe [ 1 ] . The announcement describes it as a model for structured decisions that returns all outputs in a single query, trained with a method called reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions; for high-cardinality choices it scores candidates independently and then makes an explicit choice. The announcement also states that its workflow evaluations use the predictions of large external models as reference probabilities. The training objective itself is not specified in detail. The JevAny documentation [ 14 ] describes an openly documented system of the same type. Its released models keep the backbone weights frozen and train low-rank (LoRA, rank 8) adapters together with a scoring head; training uses either a hard target or a normalized soft target distribution over the candidates; and a temperature fitted on a separate calibration set is applied to the candidate scores. Jev also appears as one of the AI judges in the adapted imitation game of Burakov [ 4 , Chap. 1] .
blocks.zh: Jev是由TypeSafe[1]发布的候选得分模型. 该公告称其为结构化决定的模式,在一次查询中返回所有产出,经过培训后采用一种称为强化学习的方法来校正决定;对于高心率选择,它独立评分候选人,然后作出明确的选择. 该公告还称,其工作流程评价将大型外部模型的预测作为参考概率. 培训目标本身没有详细说明。 JevAny文件[14]描述了一种公开记录的同类系统。 其所发布的模型保持了主干重量被冻结并训练了低等(LORA,排名8)适配器与分数头;训练使用硬靶或对考生进行正常的软靶分配;对考生的分数采用单独校正套装的温度. Jev也作为AI评委之一出现在了被改编为"布拉科夫"的模仿游戏 [4, 第1章].

blocks.en: These descriptions identify three mechanisms that bear on the meaning of the output probabilities. Soft targets and reference probabilities make the output of a teacher the quantity that the student learns to reproduce [ 12 ] . A frozen backbone restricts the student to functions of a fixed representation. Temperature calibration changes the scale of the scores without changing their ranking [ 11 ] . Because the full Jev objective is not public, we do not model Jev. We analyze each mechanism in a Gaussian surrogate in which the finite-sample risk and the calibration curve can be computed exactly, and we state which conclusions depend on the Gaussian assumptions.
blocks.zh: 这些描述确定了影响输出概率含义的三种机制. 软目标与参考概率使教师的输出量与学生所学会的再生量[12]. 被冻结的骨干限制学生行使固定代表职能. 温度校正会改变分数的分数尺度而不改变分数排名[11]. 因为Jev的完整目标不是公开的,所以我们不模拟Jev. 我们用高斯代位法分析每一种机制,其中可以精确计算出有限的样本风险和校正曲线,我们指出哪些结论取决于高斯假设。

blocks.en: Section 3 treats least squares with Gaussian random design. The outcome-supervised risk is classical [ 3 ] ; the teacher-target and mixed-supervision risks follow from the same inverse-Wishart calculation and are included for completeness. Section 4 gives the exact risk of a student restricted to a fixed linear representation and trained on a mixture of outcomes and teacher targets, in the case where the teacher depends on directions that the representation discards and the two target errors are correlated (Theorem 4.3 ). From it we obtain the optimal teacher weight and a projection identity for the teacher bias that the compressed student inherits. Section 5 turns to a binary outcome under a Gaussian-probit model. It gives the calibration curve of a teacher with an arbitrary coefficient distortion (Theorem 5.3 ), shows that the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling and gives the residual Brier risk after recalibration in closed form (Corollary 5.4 ). Section 6 states the coherence condition for candidate scores, Section 7 reports Monte Carlo checks, including designs that violate the Gaussian assumption, and Section 8 tests the predictions on credit card complaints, where the evidence is text and the true probability is unknown.
blocks.zh: 第3节用高斯随机设计处理最小平方. 结果监督的风险是经典的[3];教师目标风险和混合监督风险来自相同的倒向-Wishart计算,并计入完整性。 第4节给出了学生仅限于固定线性表述并接受结果和教师目标混合培训的准确风险,如果教师依赖于表述丢弃的方向和两个目标错误相关(定理4.3.). 我们从中获得了最佳的教师体重 和被压缩的学生继承的教师偏好投影特征。 第5节在高斯-probit模型下转向二进制结果. 它给出了教师任意系数扭曲的校正曲线(Theorem 5.3 ),表明准确的校正图是温度缩放,在以闭合形式进行校正后给布赖尔留下的风险(Corollary 5.4 ). 第6节规定了候选人分数的一致性条件,第7节报告了蒙特卡洛检查,包括违反高斯假设的设计,第8节测试了信用卡投诉的预测,其中证据为文字,真实概率不明.

blocks.en: The normalization in Proposition 6.1 is Luce’s choice model [ 16 ] , and the assumption that weights do not depend on the other candidates is his choice axiom. Under that assumption, invariance to reordering holds automatically, and ( 24 ) is the additional condition required for refinement. blocks.en: 8 Application: relief decisions on credit card complaints
blocks.zh: 8 申请:关于信用卡投诉的救济决定

blocks.en: We tested the predictions of Sections 3 – 6 on a credit decision in which the evidence is text and the true probability is unknown, and the direction of every prediction held. When a consumer complains about a credit card, the issuer closes the complaint with monetary relief, with non-monetary relief or with an explanation. A bank can estimate the probability of monetary relief from the complaint and escalate the likely cases. Missing such a case costs more than reviewing one that did not need it, so the decision is taken at a low cutoff.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了第3 — 第6节的预测 在一个信用决定上,其中证据是文字,而真实的概率是未知的,以及每个预测的方向。 消费者对信用卡投诉时,由发行人以货币减免,非货币减免或者解释等方式结案. 一家银行可以估计从投诉中获得资金减免的概率,并使可能的案件升级. 缺少这种案件比审查不需要的案件花费更多,因此决定是在一个低的截止日期作出的。

blocks.en: 8.1 Data and models
blocks.zh: 8.1 数据和模型

blocks.en: The Consumer Complaint Database of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) publishes complaints with the consumer’s narrative where the consumer consented, with personal details removed [ 5 ] . The CFPB announced on 14 August 2026 that it would stop publishing narratives; we use the archive of all narratives received up to that date [ 6 ] . We keep credit card complaints closed with one of the three responses and split them by the year received: 37,520 from 2015–2018 train the teacher, 97,835 from 2019–2023 train the students, 34,957 from 2024 serve for calibration and 61,209 from 2025–2026 for testing, after removing 1,088 narratives that occur in more than one split. These are pools. Of the 97,835 student complaints, 4,000 are held out for early stopping and each student is trained on n = 64,000 n=64{,}000 drawn from the other 93,835. The recalibration curves are fitted on 5,000 of the 34,957 calibration complaints, and every model is evaluated on the same 10,000 of the 61,209 test complaints, a fixed set that makes the bootstrap comparisons paired and keeps the cost of scoring the students down. The share with monetary relief falls from 0.206 in the teacher years to 0.166 in the test years. Every model sees the company, the issue and the narrative. The label is the company’s decision, and the models predict that decision, as a triage model would.
blocks.zh: 消费者财务保护局的消费者投诉数据库(CFPB)在消费者同意的情况下发布投诉,删除个人细节[5]。 CFPB于2026年8月14日宣布停止发表叙事;我们使用截至该日收到的所有叙事的档案[6]. 我们用三个答复中的一个结案,并逐年分拆:2015-2018年培训教师37,520起,2019-2023年培训学生97,835起,2024年提供校正34,957起,2025-2026年提供测试61,209起,此前删除了一次分拆发生的1,088起叙述. 这些是游泳池 在97 835起学生投诉中,4 000起为提前停课,每个学生接受n=64 000 n=64{,}000项培训,来自其他93 835起。 在34,957项校正投诉中,有5,000项对校正曲线进行了调整,每件模型都对61,209项测试投诉中的同1万项进行了评估,这是一套固定的组合,使靴子比较对齐,使学生的评分费用降低。 获得货币减免的份额从教师年份的0.206下降到测试年份的0.166. 每个模型都能看到公司,问题和叙述. 标签是公司的决定,模型会以分门别类的模式来预测这一决定。

blocks.en: The teacher is a multinomial logistic regression on word and bigram TF-IDF features of the narrative with indicators for the company and the issue, fitted on the teacher years only. It plays the part of the scorecard a bank already has. Because it was fitted on 2015–2018 and the students on 2019–2023, it is fixed relative to the students’ sample, as Section 9 requires. Two zero-shot readings ask a model to choose one lettered option and renormalize its next-token distribution over the letters: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct [ 21 ] , served with vLLM [ 15 ] , and the method published as a local Jev [ 8 ] , with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct [ 20 ] and a fixed threshold. Each complaint is read with three options {monetary relief, non-monetary relief, explanation only} and with two options {monetary relief, no monetary relief}, each in two orders, and each format is averaged over its orders. The students follow the JevAny design [ 14 ] (Figure 2 ): the input is the company, the issue and the narrative, cut at 384 tokens, followed by the question and the candidates in brackets; Qwen2.5-0.5B [ 20 ] with rank-8 LoRA adapters [ 13 ] on its seven projection matrices reads it, and a linear score at each candidate’s closing bracket is normalized over the candidates shown. One student is trained on the companies’ responses and one on the teacher’s probabilities, each on n = 64,000 n=64{,}000 complaints from 2019–2023 with soft cross-entropy, questions with two or three options in random order and early stopping on 4,000 held-out complaints. Two fixed representations sit between the teacher and the students, each with a logistic regression fitted to the companies’ responses on the same 64,000 complaints as the students: the mean of the last hidden layer of Qwen2.5-0.5B with its weights frozen, which is the frozen-backbone design of Section 4 , and the mean of word2vec vectors [ 17 ] trained without labels on the 2015–2018 narratives, so that the representation is fixed before the students’ sample is drawn. blocks.en: Section 8 carries out the second of the following tests on credit card complaints, a version of the first, and, with the frozen-backbone and word2vec representations, a version of the third. The first perturbs the serialization of a fixed tabular record (field order, number formatting and label wording) and measures the variation of the output probability within an observation. The second divides one candidate into mutually exclusive subcandidates and measures the departure from ( 23 ). The third compares a candidate-scoring model with a frozen pretrained embedding followed by a conventional calibrated classifier or kernel method, both trained on the same observations and evaluated with proper scores on held-out outcomes over paired splits and seeds. The present analysis gives the statistical tradeoffs that such a comparison involves but does not predict its outcome. In Section 8 the perturbation is the wording and order of the candidates, and the comparison is between a logistic teacher, zero-shot readings, two fixed representations with logistic heads and LoRA students on the same complaints. That application uses one training run per student and one training size, so the crossover sample size was not located; its label is a company’s decision, which encodes the company’s policy as well as the content of the complaint; and its models lie outside the Gaussian, probit and fixed-representation assumptions, so it tests the direction of the results; their values do not carry over.
blocks.zh: 第8节对信用卡投诉进行下列测试中的第二个测试,第一个测试版本,加上被冻结的后骨和文字2vec表述,第三个测试版本. 第一个扰动了固定表格记录的序列化(字段顺序,数字格式和标签措辞)并测量了观测中输出概率的变化. 第二,将一名候选人分成相互排斥的副候选人,并衡量偏离(23)。 第三种方法将候选人评分模型与被冻结的预先训练的嵌入模型相提并论,然后是常规的校准分解器或内核方法,两者都经过同样的观察培训,并在对分和种子进行适当评分。 本分析提供了这种比较所涉及的统计取舍,但没有预测其结果。 在第8节中,骚扰是候选人的措辞和顺序,比较的是一名后勤教师、零射读数、两名有后勤主管的固定陈述和LORA学生对同样申诉的比较。 该应用采用每名学生一次培训和一次培训规模,因此没有找到交叉抽样规模;其标签是公司的决定,它将公司的政策以及投诉的内容编码;其模型在高斯、普鲁比特和固定代表假设之外,因此它测试了结果的方向;其价值没有延续。

blocks.en: Finally, predicting an outcome and selecting an action are different problems. A recommendation label may encode a human policy, a teacher’s judgment or an optimization rule, and the appropriate target and loss depend on which of these is to be predicted. When actions change outcomes, causal assumptions are required in addition to the statistical ones used here.
blocks.zh: 最后,预测结果和选择行动是不同的问题。 推荐标签可以编码一项人的政策、教师的判断或优化规则,适当的目标和损失取决于预测其中哪一项。 当动作改变结果时,除了此处使用的统计假设外,还需要因果假设.

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10 结论

blocks.en: Under Gaussian surrogates the three training ingredients documented for candidate-scoring models have exact consequences. Training on teacher targets leaves a risk floor equal to the teacher’s coefficient bias, so it improves on outcome supervision only below a crossover sample size. A fixed representation trades the representation loss B A B_{A} against the estimation variance; it also projects the teacher bias onto the retained directions and moves the unrepresented teacher signal into the variance. The optimal teacher weight depends on the sample size, the teacher distortion and the correlation of the target errors. In the probit model, temperature scaling corrects a teacher whose coefficient has the right direction, and a residual excess, given in closed form, remains when the direction is wrong. The regression formulas assume a Gaussian design; under a multivariate- t t design the simulated risk exceeds them by up to 35 % 35\% at n = 12 n=12 , and the discrepancy shrinks as n n grows. On credit card complaints the direction of each result held outside these assumptions: a student trained on a teacher stayed at the teacher’s decision cost while a student trained on outcomes went past it, recalibration left a large zero-shot model worse than a logistic regression, Turing’s calibration check accepted a constant forecast and rejected the best model, and a model reading all candidates in one context departed from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans.
blocks.zh: 在高斯人代言下,为候选人评分模型所记录的三种训练成分产生了确切的后果. 关于教师目标的培训留下了相当于教师系数偏差的风险底线,因此,它只在交叉抽样规模以下改进成果监督。 固定代表制将代表损失B A B Q Q = A 与估计差异进行交易;它还预测教师偏向保留方向,并将无人任职的教师信号移入差异。 最佳师资权重取决于样本大小,师资扭曲以及目标出错的相关性. 在道由模型中,温度缩放纠正了一个其系数有正确方向的老师,而以封闭形式给出的剩余过量,当方向错误时仍然会存在. 回归公式假设一种高斯式设计;在多变量-t t设计下,模拟风险在n=12n=12时会超过其35%-35-%,而差异会随着nnn的增长而缩小. 在信用卡方面,除了这些假设之外,每个结果的方向都存在:一名受过教师培训的学生在教师决定费用的情况下继续留任,而接受结果培训的学生则经过这一费用,重新校正留下了一个比后勤回归更糟糕的大型零射出模型,图灵的校正检查接受了不断的预测,并拒绝了最佳模型,一种情况下读出所有候选人的模型在17.5分贝中偏离了一致性条件。

blocks.en: For practitioners the results suggest five checks. 1. Training target. A model trained on teacher or reference probabilities estimates the teacher’s conditional distribution. Its error against outcomes includes a teacher bias that more student data does not remove (Proposition 3.2 ) and that agreement with the teacher does not reveal ( 21 ). 2. Evaluation. Proper scores should be computed on realized outcomes. The model should be compared with a conventional classifier fitted to the same outcomes and with one fitted to the same teacher probabilities, so that the effect of the architecture is separated from the effect of the training target. 3. Pretrained representations. A fixed representation reduces estimation variance. It lowers the risk only while the signal it discards is below the threshold ( 10 ), and the threshold decreases as the sample grows. 4. Calibration. Recalibration corrects the scale of a forecast. A calibrated forecast can retain the excess risk ( 20 ) of a wrong coefficient direction, and calibration diagnostics do not detect it. 5. Coherence. The same event should receive the same probability under different candidate sets ( 23 ), which can be tested by posing the event under several sets.
blocks.zh: 对从业人员来说,结果建议进行五次检查。 1. 培训目标。 一个受过教师或参考概率培训的模型估计了教师的有条件分布。 它对结果的错误包括教师的偏见,即更多的学生数据不删除(建议3.2),与教师的协议不披露(21)。 2. 评价。 应根据已实现的结果计算适当的分数。 该模型应当与符合相同结果的常规分级器和符合同一教师概率的分级器作比较,从而将建筑效果与培训目标的效果相分离。 3. 训练有素的陈述。 固定员额减少估计数差异。 它只在被丢弃的信号低于阈值(10)时才降低风险,而阈值随着样本的增加而降低. 4. 校准。 重新校正了预测的尺度。 校正预测可以保留错误系数方向的超高风险(20),而校正诊断无法检测出. 5. 一致性。 同一事件在不同的候选组合(23个)下应获得相同的概率,这种概率可以通过将事件置于多个组合下来测试。

blocks.en: A model that predicts which candidate an annotator, a teacher or a past policy would select has not been shown to select the action with the best outcome. Establishing that requires a model of outcomes given actions and, when actions change outcomes, causal assumptions.
blocks.zh: 还没有显示一个模型可以预测哪个候选人是一名注释员、一名教师或一个过去的政策所选择的,以便选择有最佳结果的行动。 建立这种机制需要一种特定行动的结果模式,当行动改变结果时,需要一种因果假设。
